title: The JoomlArt demo banner shows only on a demo whose template is on Design inspiration; demos with a card keep it
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/build-with-tracy-demo.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/tracy-badge.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/badge-setting.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/bar-badge.test.mjs. Read the pass/fail counts and the three tests named 'the demo banner shows only on a template Design inspiration offers', 'the demo banner keeps showing when the template list cannot be read' and 'the list rides in the script; without one the script is unchanged'.

S2: Read the script this checkout serves, without a stand: node --input-type=module -e "import {badgeRoutes} from './apps/tracy-web/src/badge/route.js'; const row=(t)=>({tag:'quickstart/'+t+'/j6',release:{name:'quickstart/'+t+'/j6',kind:'quickstart',github:'published',assets:[]},setting:{platform:'joomla',version:'1.0.0',template:t,label:t},inspiration:{blurb:'x'},inspiration_hidden:false,tracy:null,reason:null,fetched_at:null}); const app=badgeRoutes({config:{origin:'https://cowork.tracy.ai'},pool:{query:async(s)=>/quickstart_releases/.test(s)?{rows:[row('ja-kinetic'),{...row('ja-hidden'),inspiration_hidden:true}]}:{rows:[]}}}); const r=await app.fetch(new Request('https://cowork.tracy.ai/build-with-tracy-demo.js')); const s=await r.text(); console.log(r.status, r.headers.get('access-control-allow-origin'), /var OFFERED = (.*)/.exec(s)[1])". Record the printed line.

S3: Fetch https://cowork.tracy.ai/api/templates and keep the list of templates[].id (the gallery production offers now). Check that ja-kinetic, ja-phio and ja-vega are on it and ja-titan, ja-aiga and ja-teline-v are not; if that changed, stop with BLOCKED and name which id moved (the probe refuses to run in that case).

S4: From the TCH checkout run: node tasks/evidence/demo-banner-offered/probe.mjs (it attaches to the chrome-watch CDP endpoint of the common setup, http://127.0.0.1:9222 or CDP_URL, opens its own contexts there, never closes a page or the browser, and prints {"browser":"cdp ..."} first) > $Q/probe.log 2>&1; record the exit code. It needs network access to *.demo.joomlart.com and cowork.tracy.ai and takes about 4 minutes; it opens one demo at a time with a 6 s pause (demo.joomlart.com blocks an address that opens many pages at once). If every demo in the log has an error containing ERR_CONNECTION or Timeout, stop with BLOCKED 'demo.joomlart.com unreachable'.
S5: Read the three run lines of $Q/probe.log (filtered, unfiltered, unpublished) and the last line (the checks). For each run and each of the six demos record template, served, tag, shown and href.
expect: S1: 0 failures, and the three named tests pass.
S2: prints exactly: 200 * ["ja-kinetic"]  (a release unpublished from the gallery is not on the list).
S5 every run: each demo has served 1 and tag equal to its own template id (the page ran this checkout's script, not production's).

S5 filtered: offeredInScript equals the number of ids read in S3; ja-kinetic, ja-phio and ja-vega have shown true and href 'https://cowork.tracy.ai/design-inspiration?open=<id>&provider=JoomlArt'; ja-titan, ja-aiga and ja-teline-v have shown false and href null.
S5 unfiltered: offeredInScript null; all six demos have shown true.
S5 unpublished: offeredInScript is one less than in filtered; ja-kinetic has shown false; ja-phio and ja-vega have shown true; ja-titan, ja-aiga and ja-teline-v have shown false.
S5 last line: scriptCarriesList, everyDemoLoadedTheBranchScript, offeredShowLinked, notOfferedHidden, unreadableListShowsAll and unpublishedHidesOnlyIt are all true, and PASS is true.

selectors.script-list: var OFFERED = <json> in the served script

evidence: Scan of 05/10/2026 in Chrome over 169 JoomlArt demos: 61 carried the banner and 36 of them (ja-aiga ... ja-titan) had no card on cowork.tracy.ai, so the button opened the gallery on nothing. tasks/evidence/demo-banner-offered/ holds the scan and the probe run on unmodified develop a3c4a55a0, where all six demos keep the banner (PASS false).
fence: inspirationTemplateIds (same templateCards as GET /api/templates) written into the script by badge/route.js, and the OFFERED check at the top of buildWithTracyScript; an unreadable list serves null and the banner draws as before.
